title: MUFG Bank says about 6.5 million customer records leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
date_note: Date is MUFG Bank's notice of 18 November; the bank says the unauthorized access to PLAID's KARTE occurred on 13 November and PLAID reported the scope of the leak to the bank on 17 November.
summary: MUFG Bank said on 18 November that customer information leaked after a third party gained unauthorized access on 13 November to KARTE, a service of its contractor PLAID. The leaked items are gender, age and region of residence, about 6.5 million records; the bank says no name, address, phone number or email address was included, its own systems were not accessed, and no misuse has been confirmed so far.
plain: Japan's MUFG Bank says about 6.5 million records with customers' gender, age and region leaked through its contractor PLAID's KARTE service. Names and contact details were not included, the bank says.
exec: About 6.5 million bank customer records exposed through a vendor's customer-messaging tool, not the bank's own systems.
action: MUFG Bank urges customers not to reply to or act on unexpected emails, SMS or calls posing as the bank, and to contact its support desk if they entered passwords or PINs on a fake site.

sources.name: SmartScope (English, summarising MUFG Bank's release), 18 Nov 2026

evidence.quote: The leaked information consists of customer gender, age, and residential region (prefecture or designated city) provided to PLAID under an outsourcing contract, totaling approximately 6.5 million records.
Mitsubishi UFJ Bank confirmó el 18 de noviembre de 2026 que aproximadamente 6,5 millones de registros

validation.note: Primary: MUFG Bank's own notice of 18 Nov (read in full) gives about 6.5 million records (約650万件), the data items, the 13 Nov access and 17 Nov scope report, no own-system access and no confirmed misuse. Impress Watch (18 Nov) and FinanceFeeds (22 Nov) independently report the 6.5 million figure; SmartScope's English summary of the bank's release is cited for the English figure quote. A separate victim from the other PLAID KARTE events (DHC, SMBC, ZOZO, Marui); MUFG group affiliates (WealthNavi, MUFG Trust, eSmart Securities, Morgan Stanley MUFG Securities) were not written up here.
